bullets: Added image generation to the agent runtime, creating files from text prompts for use in projects.
Fixed desktop installer filenames to use short, six-character codes instead of long strings.
Improved the desktop app to allow side chats to read files from their parent chat's private workspace.
Organized the integrations list into nine categories and added short descriptions for each app.
Removed the minimum monthly spend requirement for sponsored ad campaigns.
Updated Discord community size claims from over 7,000 to over 22,000 members.
